name: Boffalora sopra Ticino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Boffalora sopra Ticino (a bridge and a river) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI BOFFALORA SOPRA TICINO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Boffalora sopra Ticino, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by royal decree on 9 November 1933.

features.role: Boffalora sopra Ticino arms — bridge over a river, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI BOFFALORA SOPRA TICINO arched above the arms
